title: Capture a Gemini CLI quota sample
goal: A neutral sample of the Gemini CLI's documented quota output for the adapter
acceptance: The owner runs the copy-paste command the step gives and pastes the output with account identifiers removed
The sample shows which fields hold the used share, window and reset time
privacy: Ledger metadata and invented fixtures only; no transcripts or personal data.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14: one CLI run and a paste. Not a measurement.
